split_rule.unit: complete acquisition direction; adjacent frames never cross splits
split_rule.rationale: Both splits contain all four region-by-ISO strata while opposite directions image different tunnel walls. The split was frozen before sweep inference.

limitations: The original frozen threshold 0.55 result remains the primary endpoint; this sweep is explicitly post-hoc.
The no-visible component count is a human-visible-reference burden proxy, not physical false-positive truth.
A threshold shift alone is detector recalibration, not proof that restoration improved ranking or generalization.
The two splits are opposite directions within one tunnel and do not establish multi-facility generalization.
The analysis uses one frozen D2-only detector architecture.
